probes.question: In which year did Stockholms Banco begin printing banknotes?
True or false: the bank's notes became popular because they were much easier to carry than large copper daler.

image.alt: Illustration of an old paper banknote with a round seal and handwritten-style lines, next to a small stack of coins

panels.text: Sweden, 1650s. Johan Palmstruch founds Stockholms Banco in Stockholm in 1657.
Large copper daler coins are heavy. Previously the large coins had to be transported by horse and cart.
In 1661 the bank begins to make out credit notes in round denominations, freely transferable and backed by the promise of future payment in metal.
The notes become very popular very quickly because they are much easier to carry. But the bank runs into financial difficulties and is liquidated in 1667.
